production_candidate_mismatch_note: V_rawplus candidate artifact (models/model_records/mission_E_hardneg/models.joblib) is a DIFFERENT packaging than the altman_runtime native member files in models/production/altman_native/. This is expected and mandated by the two distinct model lineages/artifacts. For Gate B/C parity, the binding is: (1) the 48-contract feature identity is models/feature_contract.json + ALTMAN_NATIVE_FEATURES (identical to cfg.features_used); (2) the candidate's model logic is reproduced by joblib-loading models.joblib; (3) production inference uses src/risk_engine/altman_native_ensemble.py over models/production/altman_native/{xgb,lgb,cb,scaler}_native.joblib. Gate B/C below must be run against the correct paired path per question (offline candidate reproduction vs production inference path).
